name: Cinematic braam: sine sub + two light-unison saws, curved pitch envelope, swept formant layer
goal: Build a trailer-style cinematic braam from an init patch: sine sub one octave down plus two 3-voice saws at ~10% detune, all through one low-cut filter with random drift, a slow one-shot curved envelope pushing global pitch and opening an FX filter, a formant filter blended in by a second slow envelope, then soft-clip drive, high-pass, wide dark reverb, upper-band compression and mono lows below 120 Hz.

source.title: Vital Sound Design: Build Cinematic Braams from Scratch

prerequisites: Wavetable/VA synth with 3 oscillators, 2 filters (one with formant mode), 2+ LFOs that can run one-shot/envelope mode, random modulator, mod matrix, FX rack; a DAW reverb send bus and a mono-below-frequency utility

inputs.name: root_note
inputs.description: Low note or cluster to play (braams sit low; sub osc is −1 oct)

inputs.name: tempo
inputs.description: Host BPM; the slow envelopes are tempo-synced to ~4 bars in the source

outputs.name: braam_patch
outputs.description: Layered braam voice with pitch/formant/filter motion

outputs.name: braam_render
outputs.description: Rendered hit, lows mono below ~120 Hz

steps.action: Start from an init patch. Osc 1: basic sine, phase randomization 0, transpose −1 octave (the sub/body).
steps.expect: Clean sine one octave under the played note

steps.action: Osc 2: saw, phase randomization 0, 3 unison voices, unison detune ~10%; apply a formant/spectral scale warp around ~36% and give it a small random-modulator amount for drift.
steps.expect: Slightly thick, vocal-tinged saw that wanders subtly

steps.action: Osc 3: saw, phase randomization 0, 3 voices, detune ~10 (no warp).
steps.expect: Second saw adds density without wide chorus

steps.action: Route osc 1–3 into Filter 1 (low-pass style): lower the resonance/peak slightly, cutoff around the lower third of the range (~35 on a 0–127-ish scale), and add a random modulator to cutoff at a small amount.

Filter 2: formant type (A-O-I-E vowel), formant position 0, mix 0. Shape LFO 2 as a single rise, set it to one-shot/envelope mode at ~4 bars (4/1), and route it to Filter 2 mix so the vowel character fades in over the hit.
steps.expect: Vowel/growl colour blooms over the first bars

steps.action: LFO 1: draw a custom multi-point curve (low start, quick rise, dip, rise at end) with curved segments; envelope mode, 4/1 length. Route LFO 1 → global pitch transpose at a small amount (~5 in the source's units).
steps.expect: Pitch bends/swells over the hit instead of sitting static

steps.action: FX order: distortion first (soft clip, ~10 dB drive) → EQ with high-pass on → FX filter with resonance 0 and cutoff low, LFO 1 opening that cutoff → reverb with its low-cut raised high (the source slides the band to ~102 semitones), time ~2.3 s, size ~40%, mix ~74% → multiband compressor with upper band pushed (~18 dB).
steps.expect: Gritty, wide, dark-to-open braam with long tail

steps.action: After the synth: a utility set to mono everything below ~120 Hz, then also send the track to the shared reverb send channel.
steps.expect: Low end stays centred; braam sits in the same space as the rest of the cue

verification: Sub sine is one octave below the played note and stays mono below ~120 Hz
LFO 1 runs once per note (envelope mode) and moves both pitch and FX-filter cutoff
Formant filter mix starts at 0 and rises with LFO 2
Distortion precedes EQ/filter/reverb in the FX order
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there. Numbers quoted are the presenter's approximate values, in the source synth's own units.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Vital/Ableton/Dune/Massive X/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for a Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with plugin/synth vendors named in the source video.
Vital-specific units (e.g. cutoff 35, transpose amount 5, reverb band 102 semitones) are approximate; match by ear in other synths.

For Web Audio: sine+2 saw OscillatorNodes, BiquadFilter + formant bandpass bank, AudioParam automation curves (setValueCurveAtTime) for the one-shot envelopes, WaveShaper soft clip, ConvolverNode reverb.
